title: LA1--LA6: actual segment geometry, saturation, monomial assembly and exact degrees
status: Human mathematical reconstruction with exact pinned source records; no Lean modification, build or whole-proof verification claim.

claims.result: Actual periodic frame geometry gives unique late and old occurrences, full selected-position coverage and exactly the adjacent-frame overlaps.
claims.status: Proved by partitioning one-period half-open intervals and using the literal no-selected-letter gaps inside frames.

claims.result: A_j=max(z_j,H+s_j) exactly controls Pz and Qc; all exponent signs, overlap factors and periodic identities follow, including product Q_j=p^n'.
claims.status: Proved from natural floor/logarithm identities and ordered periodic frames; no large-parameter approximation or separate geometric input.

claims.result: The actual Mj lattices are saturated finite free modules whose integral bases reduce independently.
claims.status: Proved from the actual XX' paired path-basis identification CG1, then exact support intersections, finite monomial boxes and uniformizer division. CG1 is explicitly shared; no characteristic-zero isotypic claim is used.

claims.result: The exact label/segment exponent map is injective simultaneously over all LA/EE support families: RestLamInj.
claims.status: Proved by two quotient/remainder steps at frame plane coordinates, one step elsewhere, and recovery of e from exact current-frame row sums.

claims.result: All assembled support monomials have exact target row degrees a', and labels satisfy IsCLabel: RestLamDeg 1088.
claims.status: Proved using only shared RS3's narrow numerical margin to obtain e<nz and justify cancellation of natural subtraction; the full RestPad detour is avoided.

claims.result: sum_(ell in LA)sum_(e in EE(ell))product_j rank_O Mj(bfam) <= dim_f LamBar: full RestLam 1088.
claims.status: Proved by an injective direct sum of monomial tensor spaces, residue-independent actual bases and exact membership in lamGen. Individual segment dimensions are not estimated here.

shared_reconstructed_inputs.result: Actual XX' equals the same allowed integral paired path-basis span over O and the residue field, hence is saturated. CG1's proof has been independently cross-reviewed against IP3--IP4 and the literal source segPairs/XX' definitions.
shared_reconstructed_inputs.application: m(x)=m0=kNs+1>=0, theta=thc(j,b), o=oc(j); segN+r<=Ns+r<=K. Only identification/saturation, not the characteristic-zero joint-type clause.

shared_reconstructed_inputs.result: a'_t/P_j(y)>=(36/5)Yk^2Ns for every actual segment letter, proved from Dat.Hyp via RS2's exact determinant loss.
shared_reconstructed_inputs.application: Use y=current-frame x in segment j+1, so P_(j+1)(x)=P_j(x)Q_j. This proves all degree nonunderflow uniformly in ell,e.
